SF Rec & Parks：Music Concourse 交通: SF Rec & Parks: Getting to Music Concourse
44 路停靠音乐广场，连接公园南北两侧。: Route 44 stops at Music Concourse and connects the park's north and south sides.
想在旧金山过一个好看的下午，不一定要先挑一张门票。把白色温室当作背景，在没有汽车: A lovely San Francisco afternoon doesn't have to start with a ticket. Use the white Conservatory as your backdrop, wander along car-free JFK Promenade, pause at a piano, and spread lunch out on the lawn. The small discoveries along the way make this route ideal when the week has worn you out but you don't want to spend the whole weekend indoors.
时间：建议预留 2.5–3 小时，不含往返交通；这是编辑建议，沿途没有必须赶上的: Time: Allow 2.5–3 hours, excluding travel. This is an editorial suggestion; there are no sessions you must rush to catch.
路线：Conservatory of Flowers 外侧草坪 → JFK Pr: Route: Lawn outside the Conservatory of Flowers → JFK Promenade → Music Concourse. The main route stays in the park's eastern half; it does not extend to Ocean Beach or the Golden Gate Bridge.
费用：主线是公共户外空间，免门票；Muni、跨城交通、外买餐饮及进入收费场馆的费: Costs: the main route uses public outdoor spaces with no admission fee. Muni, intercity travel, purchased food, and entry to paid venues cost extra. You can complete the main route with your own lunch and water.
预约：普通散步无需订路线名额；团体包场、预留野餐区或加入场馆活动，需按该项目另查: Reservations: ordinary walks don't require a route reservation. Group bookings, reserved picnic areas, and venue activities have separate requirements.
天气：选无强风、无明显降雨的白天。带一件挡风外套，别只凭自己出门时的南湾气温打包: Weather: Choose daytime without strong wind or significant rain. Bring a wind-resistant layer; don't pack based only on the South Bay temperature when you leave home.
先定集合点，再决定从哪一侧进园: Choose a meeting point before deciding which side to enter
把集合点写成“Conservatory of Flowers 外侧草坪，100: “The lawn outside the Conservatory of Flowers, 100 John F. Kennedy Drive” is a much clearer meeting point than “the entrance to Golden Gate Park.” The park is long. If one person navigates to the ocean and another to the east end, you'll spend your walking time catching up with each other.
Muni 5 沿北侧 Fulton Street、7 可接 Haight/Sta: Muni 5 follows Fulton Street on the north side, 7 connects to the Haight/Stanyan area, and 44 reaches Music Concourse. Check SFMTA's current routes for your exact stop and transfers. If the 44 is easier for you, start at Music Concourse and walk in reverse; you don't need an extra ride just to follow the guide's order. Allow separately for cross-bay or Peninsula fares and transfer time.
三站慢走：从白色温室走到音乐广场: Three easy stops: From the white conservatory to Music Concourse
下面的停留时间用于安排节奏，不是步行导航。点开每一站的地图确认位置；遇到场地封闭: The suggested stop durations below help set your pace; they aren't walking directions. Open each stop's map to confirm its location and skip any closed area.
第一站 · 温室前拍照，再看一小片花: Stop 1 · Photograph the conservatory, then look at a few flowers
给外侧草坪和白色建筑留 30–40 分钟。先拍一张宽景，再找一个喜欢的花形；有余: Allow 30–40 minutes for the outside lawn and white building. Take a wide shot, then find a flower shape you like. If you have energy, visit nearby Dahlia Garden. Blooms change with the season; archival photos do not guarantee flowers on the day.
用 40–60 分钟走向 Music Concourse。看到公共钢琴、艺术设施: Allow 40–60 minutes as you head toward Music Concourse. Pause for public pianos, art installations, or people practicing, and watch for cyclists and scooter riders. This is shared space; keep the path clear when taking photos or chatting.
在 Music Concourse 的公共区域休息，看看周围建筑。若当天官方日历: Rest in Music Concourse's public areas and take in the surrounding buildings. If the official calendar lists a suitable performance that day, decide whether to stay. If not, there's no need to buy another activity to fill the time. Then walk to your return stop or take the park shuttle.
午餐带到草坪，门票留给真正想看的展: Bring lunch to the lawn; save ticket money for an exhibit you really want to see
Gardens of Golden Gate Park 允许在 Conserva: Gardens of Golden Gate Park allows picnics on the lawn in front of the Conservatory. The simplest plan is to eat at the first stop: bring a mat, an easy-to-clean-up lunch, and a bag for your trash, then start walking. Don't turn lunch into a hunt for a place to sit, and don't occupy reserved or actively used event spaces.
这篇的“免门票”指户外主线。Conservatory 室内、Japanese T: “No admission fee” in this guide refers to the outdoor main route. The Conservatory interior, Japanese Tea Garden, Botanical Garden, and museum galleries each have their own entry rules. Some offer free admission to eligible visitors, but that doesn't mean every visitor, special exhibition, or date is free. If you decide to go inside, check the venue's ticket types and ID requirements before adding the cost.
走累了，免费车是有时段的: Tired feet? The free shuttle has set hours.
官方园内接驳车每天运行，但工作日是 12:00–18:00，周末和节假日是 9:: The official park shuttle runs daily: 12:00–18:00 on weekdays and 9:00–18:00 on weekends and holidays, with listed intervals of about 25 and 15 minutes respectively. Stops include the Conservatory of Flowers and Music Concourse, and some serve only one direction. It covers the park's east side; it is not a cross-park express to Ocean Beach. Check that day's notices for changes.
带孩子或长辈，就用短版: With kids or older adults, use the shorter version
只保留温室外景、草坪午餐和一小段 JFK 往返，约 60–90 分钟即可。同行者: Keep only the conservatory exterior, a lawn lunch, and a short out-and-back on JFK for about 60–90 minutes. When companions get tired, return to a stop you've already checked; you don't have to complete all three stops. Car-free park sections still have cyclists and connections to roads open to vehicles. Keep checking for traffic at crossings.
发给同伴准确集合点、散场时间和各自返程车站。: Send companions the exact meeting point, finish time, and their return transit stops.
带挡风外套、水、午餐垫和垃圾袋；先查洗手间位置。: Bring a windproof layer, water, a picnic blanket, and a trash bag. Locate restrooms first.
打开当天交通和公园公告，确认所需接驳站点、方向与开行时间。: Open that day's transit and park notices to confirm the shuttle stops, direction, and operating hours you need.
想增加室内项目时，先核票价、开放与免费身份条件，不临场默认免票。: Before adding an indoor stop, check ticket prices, opening hours, and free-admission eligibility. Don't assume it's free when you arrive.
